items.title: Robert Lewis Interview 1959-11-10
items.q: You mentioned it was a little piece that you'd heard from a Johnny Dodds record.

ctx.x: Well, he asked me to play something on the clarinet, and I played it very badly, of course. So then I came back, and he gave me a lesson.

You mentioned it was a little piece that you'd heard from a Johnny Dodds record. Oh, yeah, Stealing Away. Well, I think of it. You mentioned this afternoon that he didn't think too much of Johnny Dodds. Was that his musicianship, or what did he say?
Well, Sidney was always Sidney, and when it came to talking about other musicians, why, of course, he had to think about himself too, the way many musicians do.
